name: Medical Bay
narrativeOnEnter: Clean, white, cold. Medical equipment lines the walls. A navigation override panel is mounted on the main counter — the biometric scanner is offline, but the manual switch access is still live. The med cabinet is sealed.

action.text:
MERIDIAN STATION ALPHA — ENGINEERING SCHEMATIC
Life Support Power Reroute — Emergency Procedure

To restore life support power:
1. Open the engineering junction panel
2. Match wire connections:
   Red   → Junction A
   Blue  → Junction D
   Green → Junction B
   Yellow→ Junction C

Note: This reroutes power from secondary systems.
Command deck blast doors will unseal upon completion.

CREW MEDICAL STATUS — MERIDIAN ALPHA

CHEN, Y.   — Last scan: 48h ago. Status: EVACUATED
KOVALEV, D. — Last scan: 6h ago. Status: UNKNOWN (Reactor Deck)
PATEL, S.  — Last scan: 48h ago. Status: EVACUATED
DIAZ, M.   — Last scan: 48h ago. Status: EVACUATED

Note: Kovalev remained on station to attempt manual reactor stabilisation.
If he succeeded, structural integrity of the station was preserved.
If not — the reactor will cascade in approximately 30 minutes from lockdown.

An automated defibrillator unit. Charged and ready. Station-issue.

A label on the side:
'MERIDIAN STATION — MEDICAL INVENTORY #7'

You do not need this right now. Hopefully.
